$ rea guidance --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
rea guidance — Search or read the installed REA workflow guidance

Usage: rea guidance [options]

Options:
  --action <search|read|contents>  Guidance action to perform: search, read, or contents (the guides and their headings with locators) (default: search)
  --query <string>                 Required with search; sections covering more of its words rank first
  --locator <string>               Required with --action read; locator returned by search or contents
  --guide <string>                 With --action contents: list every heading of this guide, such as references/clone-runs.md
  --limit <value>                  Maximum search matches; search only, defaults to 3
  --cursor <string>                Continue a search page; search only

Global options (--json, --format, --filter-output, --token-limit, --timings, ...): rea help options
<end>
--- stderr
<end>
